historical_claims.source_locator: Saunders Mac Lane, Categories for the Working Mathematician (1971; 2nd ed. 1998)

description: Introduces monoidal categories through sequential and parallel composition, the tensor bifunctor, associators, unitors and pentagon and triangle coherence. Compares cartesian products, vector-space tensors and resource addition, distinguishing symmetry and braiding from extra copying and discarding structure.
